content_sections.heading: About IISER Pune
content_sections.text: The notice describes IISER Pune as a premier institute dedicated to research and teaching in the basic sciences. It says the institute was established in 2006 by the Ministry of Human Resource Development (renamed Ministry of Education in August 2020) and was declared an Institute of National Importance by an Act of Parliament in 2012. The notice is signed by the Registrar and is dated 27.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The institute invites applications from Indian nationals. The post and its conditions are described below. The prescribed educational qualification should have been obtained from recognized Universities / Institutions. Age limit: not more than 35 years as on the last date of submission of application. The prescribed date for determining the upper age limit, educational qualifications or experience is the last date for submitting applications. Age relaxation commensurate with educational qualification/s and / or experience/s may be considered for applicants having qualification and experience higher than advertised, with the prior approval of the competent authority. The experience requirement may be relaxed based on the cohort of applications received, with the prior approval of the competent authority. Candidates should read the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Tech. / MS / M.Sc in Water Resources or equivalent in related areas.
rows.preferred: Prior research experience in the field of remote sensing for flood detection.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated emoluments are Rs. 25,000 + 30% House Rent Allowance per month. Candidates holding a valid CSIR-NET / GATE / DBT-JRF / any other National Level Test conducted by Central Government Departments and their agencies, or an equivalent scorecard, get Rs. 31,000 + 30% House Rent Allowance per month. The appointment is initially for 3 months, extendable for a further period subject to continuation of the project and satisfactory performance of the incumbent. The appointment is purely temporary and terminates automatically, without any notice or compensation, on termination of the project. The appointed person has no claim of appointment or absorption in the funding agency or in IISER Pune. The appointment is governed by the terms and conditions of the funding agency applicable to this project.

content_sections.heading: IISER Pune Project Associate-I Job Description
content_sections.text: Analyze satellite data. Demarcate floods. Prepare scientific reports and manuscripts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Pune Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: Interested candidates apply online through the Project Associate-I application link given in the notice. The last date of application is 10 December 2026. The notice does not describe the individual steps of the online form. The following will be collected and verified at an appropriate stage: Photocopies of relevant certificates and other testimonials in support of age, educational qualifications, experience etc. Recent passport size colour photograph. The notice advises applicants to mention all educational qualifications and experience in the relevant field at the time of applying.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The prescribed qualifications and experience are the bare minimum, and meeting them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. If many applications are received, the Project Investigator, on the recommendation of the Screening Committee, may restrict the number of candidates called for interview to a reasonable limit, considering qualifications and experience above the minimum.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The number of posts may vary depending on requirements during the selection process. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing for the interview. No interim enquiries, correspondence or communication of any sort will be entertained. Bringing any influence, political or otherwise, will be treated as a disqualification for the post applied for. For updates, the institute website should be seen regularly.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Associate-I posts are vacant at IISER Pune?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) Project Associate-I post under the DST-funded project "Monsoon Low pressure systems: Energetics, Patterns and Flood Potential".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IISER Pune Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 10 December 2026. Applications are made online through the link given in the notice.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IISER Pune Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is M.Tech. / MS / M.Sc in Water Resources or equivalent in related areas. Prior research experience in remote sensing for flood detection is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IISER Pune Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 35 years as on the last date of submission of application. Relaxation may be considered for higher qualification and experience, with prior approval of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IISER Pune Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs. 25,000 per month plus 30% House Rent Allowance. Holders of a valid CSIR-NET / GATE / DBT-JRF / other national level test score get Rs. 31,000 plus 30% House Rent Allowance.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Project Associate-I pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice gives both pay figures as the amount plus 30% House Rent Allowance: Rs. 25,000 + 30% HRA, or Rs. 31,000 + 30% HRA for candidates with a qualifying national level test score.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for IISER Pune Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview, with the number limited by the Project Investigator on the Screening Committee's recommendation. Shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail only and the list is put on the institute website.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IISER Pune Project Associate-I post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is purely temporary and contractual, initially for 3 months and extendable subject to continuation of the project and satisfactory performance. It ends automatically when the project ends.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is admissible for appearing for the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for this IISER Pune post?
faq.answer: Indian nationals who meet the qualification and age conditions can apply. The qualification must be from a recognized University or Institution.
